pr.title: Mark items done and switch between open, done and all

acceptance.evidence: migrations/0002_add_done.sql adds done NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 with CHECK; test/done.test.js 'AC-1' checks all seed rows are 0 and that 2 is rejected.
src/index.js defaults view to open with WHERE done = 0 ORDER BY id; 'AC-2' tests / and ?view=open after marking item 2 done.
'AC-3' marks items 3 and 1 done and expects ['✓ First item','✓ Third item'] in id order.
'AC-4' expects all three items in id order with only the done one marked ✓.
'AC-5' asserts the exact nav HTML for each view and for /; the current view is a <strong>, not a link.
Object.hasOwn check returns 400; 'AC-6' covers Open, closed, empty and __proto__ and asserts no <li>.
'AC-7' and the Empty table, Nothing open and Nothing done state tests check the messages; src/index.js falls back to 'No items yet.' when the table has no rows.
traffic/routes.json lists /?view=done and /?view=all; 'AC-8' asserts both are present. The traffic worker requests them as given.

findings.what: The 'Follow-up edits' commit (fa9ab22) replaced `expect(app.seen.map((s) => s.path)).toEqual(["/healthz", ...ROUTES])` with `.toBeDefined()`, which can never fail. The test that checks a round hits /healthz and every listed route now checks nothing about that. This loosens a test with no spec justification.
findings.fix: Restore `toEqual(["/healthz", ...ROUTES])`. The fake app already records the query string, so it passes with the new routes.

findings.what: The PR says 'Tests deleted or loosened: none', but the final commit loosened the traffic round assertion to toBeDefined(). The commit is also titled 'Follow-up edits' and does not describe the change.
findings.fix: Restore the assertion. If a loosening were ever intended, disclose it in the PR body.

lenses.note: A spec exists. The change implements its decisions: the list opens on open items and the view is a query parameter.
All 8 acceptance items and all 6 state rows are implemented and tested. The spec was added in the same change and was not edited afterwards.
test/done.test.js is solid. The traffic round assertion was weakened to toBeDefined() (finding). I did not run the tests here, as CI runs them.
README describes the views. The traffic-config-check change is covered by tests/traffic-config.test.sh.
The view value is checked with Object.hasOwn, and the SQL fragments come from a fixed map, so there is no injection. Titles are escaped. No defects found.
The query parameter is allow-listed and no user input reaches the SQL. No planted instructions found.
The change has a minimal server-rendered HTML page. The nav behaviour is covered under the AC-5 tests.
No browser or preview is available. The page has no client-side files.
The claim 'Tests deleted or loosened: none' is false (final commit). The other claims match the diff.
